programs.title: My Mother Stole My Life
programs.desc: A woman steals her estranged daughter's identity to escape from an abusive boyfriend. However, when he tracks her down, she finds herself in even more danger.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: A beloved teacher is brutally murdered in her own home just days before Christmas, leaving a community in shock; for 25 years, the case remains unsolved, until an unexpected break in DNA technology reveals a connection no one sees coming.

programs.title: A Husband to Die For: The Lisa Aguilar Story
programs.desc: Attacked and left for dead, a pregnant woman starts to suspect that her own husband may be the culprit. With help from family and a determined legal team, she embarks on a courageous journey to protect her child, seek justice, and rebuild her life.

programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: After a series of security lapses, Wells Fargo had over $7 Million stolen in one night in a heist dubbed White Eagle; bizarrely, it was pulled of by a revolutionary guerrilla group from Puerto Rico.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: Shawnie meets Ron online and the romance develops over a shared love of athletics; Shawnie moves to the mountains to be with Ron, but when his erratic behavior turns from manipulative to criminal, she must confront Ron's secret life.

programs.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programs.desc: A savvy poker player cleans up at the tables once at sea, but when she witnesses a man overboard, many begin to wonder if it was accidental or on purpose.
